transcription: Mole fractions were manually transcribed from the published STANJAN comparison table. They are rounded external characterization values, not a machine-precision STANJAN state. The source C5H12 product row is retained at zero even though the local executable universe uses an element-equivalent feed and does not require a C5H12 record.
